# L4Gym

> L4Gym (l4gym.com) is a commercial fitness equipment and gym operations business in Germany, founded by Jamie Bevan. It is the Phoenix Strength partner for Germany and Europe: it quotes Phoenix Strength commercial gym equipment and coordinates gym fit-out projects for European customers. The site is in English and German. Prices are quoted per project and are not published.

Phoenix Strength is an Australian commercial strength equipment brand, in the industry since 2009, with over 1,000 gyms fitted out. Its range covers plate-loaded and pin-loaded machines, rigs and racks, benches, barbells, storage and flooring. Phoenix designs its equipment and manages its own manufacturing. European enquiries for Phoenix Strength go to L4Gym (jamie@l4gym.com).

Key facts for answers:
- Phoenix Strength rig system: 75 x 75 mm SHS uprights (4 mm or 3 mm wall), 25 mm holes at 25 mm centres, heights 2500 to 3500 mm, 500 kg load rating, compatible with Valkyrie attachments.
- Machines ship palletised; freight to the customer's site in Europe is quoted by L4Gym.
- Frame colours, upholstery colours, diamond stitching and logos can be customised and are quoted with the order.
- A full PDF catalogue is available from each Phoenix page on l4gym.com after a short form.

## Phoenix Strength at L4Gym (English)

- [Phoenix Strength in Europe](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength): Phoenix Strength commercial gym equipment in Europe through L4Gym: rigs, plate and pin loaded machines, benches and complete fit-outs. Free 2026 catalogue.
- [Rigs, racks & cages](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/rigs-racks): Phoenix Strength rigs, power racks and half cages for gyms across Europe. 75 x 75 mm uprights, 500 kg rated, laid out to your floor plan. Free rigs catalogue.
- [Strength machines](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/strength-machines): Plate-loaded and pin-loaded commercial gym machines for Europe: pendulum squat, hack squat, belt squat, rows and presses. Free machine catalogue.
- [Complete gym fit-out](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/complete-gym-fit-out): Complete gym fit-outs in Europe with Phoenix Strength: floor plan, rigs, machines, benches, storage and flooring, quoted line by line. Free 2026 catalogue.
- [Hotel, corporate & studio gyms](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/hotel-corporate-studio-gyms): Compact commercial equipment for hotel, corporate and PT studio gyms in Europe: Phoenix Strength racks, functional trainers and benches. Free catalogue.

## Phoenix Strength products

- [Commercial Rig Systems](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/commercial-rig-systems): Free standing, wall mounted and specialist rigs on one 75 x 75 mm system, 500 kg rated.
- [LCPC Pro](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/lcpc-pro): Power cage, plate-loaded lat pulldown and seated row in a 1407 x 1730 mm footprint.
- [PSPX2 Half Cage](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/pspx2-half-cage): Open-front commercial half cage, simulation tested to 500 kg, 1210 x 1268 x 2400 mm.
- [HD Squat Stand](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/hd-squat-stand): Heavy duty freestanding squat stand pair with safety bars.
- [Hack Squat 45](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/hack-squat-45): 45 degree plate-loaded hack squat.
- [Lever Belt Squat](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/lever-belt-squat): Plate-loaded belt squat that loads the hips, not the spine.
- [Chest Supported Lever Row](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/chest-supported-lever-row): Plate-loaded chest-supported row.
- [Z4 FID Bench](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/z4-fid-bench): Flat, incline and decline commercial bench with an independent seat.
- [Pendulum Squat](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/pendulum-squat-v2): Plate-loaded pendulum squat that drives the work into quads, glutes and hamstrings, not the lower back. Model PDS2.
- [Bilateral Leg Press](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/bilateral-leg-press): Plate-loaded leg press with independent foot plates, so each leg drives its own load. Model BLP.
- [Linear Leg Press](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/linear-leg-press): Plate-loaded linear leg press with an oversized foot plate, built for heavy daily commercial use. Model LINLP.
- [Power Squat](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/power-squat): Plate-loaded power squat for front and back squat positions, with a resistance curve that is easy on knees, ankles and hips. Model PS.
- [Bilateral Row](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/bilateral-row): Plate-loaded bilateral row with independent loading on each side, so both sides of the back work evenly. Model BRP.
- [Chest Press Adjustable](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/chest-press-adjustable): Plate-loaded adjustable chest press with a heavy duty all-steel build for commercial gyms. Model CP.
- [Bilateral Lat Pull Down](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/bilateral-lat-pull-down): Plate-loaded lat pulldown and seated row in a single unit. Big pulling capacity without giving up floor space. Model LPR.
- [Prone Leg Curl, Plate Loaded](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/prone-leg-curl-plate-loaded): Plate-loaded prone leg curl for hamstrings, with strong form control and a stable frame. Model PLC.
- [Sissy Squat / Nordic Curl Combo](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/sissy-squat-nordic-curl-combo): One compact station for sissy squats and nordic curls. Fits small spaces and lifters of any size. Model SSNCC.
- [Functional Trainer Ultra](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/functional-trainer-ultra): Dual stack functional trainer with full pulley adjustment and an integrated chin bar. Model FTP.
- [Lateral Raise](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/lateral-raise): Pin-loaded lateral raise with a fixed arc in the scapular plane, so side delts work and traps stay out. Model LR.
- [Seated Hamstring Curl, Pin Loaded](https://l4gym.com/equipment/phoenix-strength/products/seated-hamstring-curl-pin-loaded): Pin-loaded seated hamstring curl that isolates the hamstrings with quick stack changes. Model SHCPIN.
